_note: Venue -> neighbourhood lookup. Keys are normalizeVenueLabel outputs. Both the short form and the facility form are listed for every venue, so a single-pass V[normalizeVenueLabel(label)] lookup matches — no fallback needed. Multiple keys mapping to one canonical `name` is intentional; that's how duplicate API records collapse. Nothing renders unless it appears here.
_rules: Any label not present here is dropped, including all bare street addresses.
The starts-with-a-digit check is a second line of defence, not the mechanism.
Log dropped labels at build time so a real venue never disappears silently.
